name: Rune Warden
description: Rune Warden is a Viking shield turned into a hovering machine. Eight ivory armour plates, each engraved with its own knotwork and runes, sit between three riveted bands that cross its body like a gimbal: a brown forged spine over the crown, a strap down through each flank and a dark iron ring around the waist. Plank-built wooden shields on either side carry a carved serpent, and your face sits in a pewter frame at the front.

It is built like something a smith would be proud of: heavy, symmetrical and a little battle-worn, with eight bronze-edged horns sweeping up and down from riveted iron mounts at its waist and a reactor ring glowing on its back. The runes on its shield hubs, the rings around its crown and underside and the bars beside its face all share one light, so a single colour sets its mood, from glacier blue to forge-fire orange.

price.rationale: A dense, fully engraved design (eight knotwork plates, plank shields with a carved serpent, three riveted bands and eight horns) with a strong silhouette, though its round body shares the family look of the other orbs.

credits.title: Rune Warden bot model
credits.notes: Modelled procedurally in Blender 5.2 (build_vikings-horned-knotwork.py); the face rim reuses the bot-screen bezel profile with a lower crown. The knotwork, rune and serpent carvings, plank shading, paint wear and glow mask are own work, painted by make_textures_vikings-horned-knotwork.py. The runes are Elder Futhark signs from Noto Sans Runic (Google, SIL Open Font License 1.1), rendered into the textures; the font is not shipped.
